# Three.js r170

`three.module.min.js` is the unmodified ES module from npm `three@0.170.0`
(`package/build/three.module.min.js`). MIT license: `THREE-LICENSE.txt`.
Bundled locally for the offline Android WebView; no CDN, runtime install,
external model loader, or remote requests. The station uses procedural geometry.
Requires WebGL 2; accessible station controls remain available on failure.
